component.name: Dev Cleaner
component.summary: Reclaim disk and memory from developer caches

description.p: Dev Cleaner finds what developer machines accumulate, explains each item, and cleans it with the tool's own command where there is one. Nothing is removed until you confirm.

ul.li: Package-manager, editor and AI/ML caches: npm, pnpm, Yarn, Bun, Cargo, pip, uv, Go, Gradle, Maven, Docker, Hugging Face and more
System junk: thumbnails, journal, package caches, old Snap revisions, unused Flatpak runtimes, browser caches and the Trash
Project build folders such as node_modules, Python venvs and Rust target
Downloaded AI models from Ollama, LM Studio, Hugging Face and loose .gguf files
Processes with safe-to-end verdicts, busy ports, and system information
Back up and restore editor and AI tool configs
